title: Income-tax Act — Section 80EE (Deduction in respect of interest on loan taken for residential house property)

content.overview: Section 80EE allows a deduction from gross total income: Deduction in respect of interest on loan taken for residential house property.
content.glance: Section 80EE allows a deduction from gross total income: Deduction in respect of interest on loan taken for residential house property.
content.study: Chapter VI-A deduction. Section 80EE: Deduction in respect of interest on loan taken for residential house property. The deduction is allowed from gross total income subject to the conditions, limits and mode-of-payment rules in the section, and it cannot create a loss under the head.
